title: api-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/api-spec.md.j2 and templates/api-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from api-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

api_name.title: Api name
api_name.description: The API's name as callers will refer to it in support threads and in their own code. Match the SDK package name if one exists; two names for one API doubles your search surface.

auth_method.title: Auth method
auth_method.description: How a caller authenticates, in one or two sentences - the scheme, where the credential goes, and how long it lives. Expiry is the detail people leave out and then get paged about.

free_tier_rpm.title: Free tier rpm
free_tier_rpm.description: Requests per minute allowed on the free tier. A real number - limits described as "reasonable" get discovered by being hit, in production, at somebody else's peak hour.

pro_tier_rpm.title: Pro tier rpm
pro_tier_rpm.description: Requests per minute on the paid tier. The gap between this and the free number is the upgrade argument, so make sure it is one you would actually make out loud.

prod_base_url.title: Prod base url
prod_base_url.description: Production base URL including the version segment. Version in the path, not only in a header - the first thing an integrator copies is this line, and it has to still work next year.

staging_base_url.title: Staging base url
staging_base_url.description: Staging base URL. If there is no staging environment, say so here explicitly rather than omitting the line - integrators will otherwise test against production, and you will find out how.
